process_limits: Both example reflow temperatures can exceed the inherited TEC internal Sn-Sb melting reference near230C. They are NOT assembly recommendations. Metallization, surface preparation, solder hierarchy, stress and manufacturer process approval are unresolved.
electrical_policy: HeatSolver thermal coupons only. Separate explicit alumina volume and no TEC conductors. No fictitious physical metal conductivity in full stack, no assertion of full-device electrical isolation until integrated two-terminal topology/current re-verification.
interface_model: Each nonzero Rdoubleprime is represented by a separate2um film with k=film_thickness/Rdoubleprime. Finite-volume regularization conserves heat and reproduces resistance; no zero-thickness jump or measured intermetallic identification.
void_policy: FEM coupon full-wetted, no voids. Wetted-fraction series-resistance screen is analytical only and omits lateral spreading, pore topology and contact perimeter effects.
